summary: Tested body-region What We Treat, SEO, legacy 301s, services order, the admin SectionsEditor, slug auto-generation and 301 creation, Case Studies CMS, Reviews removal, preview, sitemap and mobile overflow. Backend: 35 of 36 pytest cases pass. The one failure: the public conditions list has 12 items, not 11, because a real published condition 'testing treatement' (id 25, created by owner admin id 1) appears as a 12th card on /what-we-treat/ and in the header. All other UI flows passed. All TEST_ data and the temporary admin were removed.

minor.issue: Returns 12 published conditions. The extra one is the real record 'testing-treatement' (id 25, owner-created, PUBLISHED). The spec expects exactly 11 body-region cards. The tester did not touch it because it is real content. The client or E1 should unpublish or archive it.
Delete is a soft delete. If a published item is renamed and then trashed, the auto 301 still points to its URL, which now 404s. Consider handling redirects when an item is trashed.

ui_bugs.issue: Admin preview renders the sections but not the RegionAnchors nav, which the public page shows. This was seen with 2 sections. Minor parity gap.

design_issues.screen: /what-we-treat/ and header What We Treat dropdown
issues: A 12th card 'testing treatement' (a test record with a typo) is visible to the public

action_items: Unpublish or archive the real condition 'testing-treatement' (id 25) so /what-we-treat/ shows exactly 11 regions, after confirming with the client
Optional: render RegionAnchors in the admin preview for conditions
Optional: on trash, deactivate or retarget auto-created redirects that point to the trashed URL
critical_code_review_comments: publicSections anchor dedupe appends '-2' repeatedly (a-2-2) instead of incrementing. Cosmetic.

ContentEditorPage: slug auto-follows the title in edit mode until the slug field is touched. This is intended, but an admin editing only a published title will change its URL without meaning to. The warning (slug-redirect-warning) does make this visible.
Case study and condition default SEO suffix is '| Prevent & Restore Physical Therapy'. Region pages use explicit seoTitle '| Prevent & Restore PT'. Check that this mix is acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Temp admin test_qa_admin@example.com (id 52) plus TEST_ conditions and case studies were created and then hard-deleted, along with their redirects and activity rows. Also removed leftover TEST_ conditions and /blogs/test-blog-* redirects from earlier iterations. Real Neck Pain record was verified unchanged (updatedAt identical).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_regions_case_studies.py. It needs the temp admin from /app/memory/test_credentials.md and REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. Admin URLs end with a trailing slash (e.g. /admin/what-we-treat/31/). Toast testids: toast-success and toast-error. Admin delete is a soft delete (deletedAt), so hard-delete TEST_ rows via prisma afterwards. Real condition Neck Pain has id 26. The draft example case study has id 1, slug example-case-study-draft.
